Cracking repaired rather than bridged with coating
Defects corrected before colour rather than after

chandler-az.lede: In Chandler paint is usually the alternative to replacement, and it is often the right one.
paras: A great many stucco elevations here are structurally fine and simply look tired, and a properly prepared and recoated wall will do everything a homeowner actually wants at a fraction of what a re-stucco costs. Where that is the case we will say so rather than quoting the larger job, which is the same position we take on tile roofs that only need underlayment.

The interiors follow the same pattern: sound houses with dated colour. A whole-house repaint is a straightforward job made good or bad entirely by preparation, masking and the number of coats, none of which are visible in a quote and all of which are visible on a wall.
notes: Recoating recommended where re-stucco is not needed
Preparation and coat count where the quality sits
Sound houses with dated colour, inside and out

gilbert-az.lede: Gilbert colours come off an approved community list, so the palette conversation comes first.
paras: Nearly every community here runs architectural review, and exterior colour is the thing it reviews most often. The scheme is chosen from what is approved for your specific community, submitted, and confirmed before a drop of paint is bought. Repainting a house a colour the committee has not approved is a letter and a second repaint.

Because the subdivisions repeat, the elevations do too, and body, trim and accent breakdowns tend to follow a known pattern across a whole street. That makes quoting quick and it makes it easy to show what a scheme will actually look like on your plan rather than on a card.
notes: Scheme approved by the committee before purchase
Body, trim and accent breakdown known per plan
Town-wide repetition makes quoting straightforward

glendale-az.lede: Painting in Glendale means working around flood irrigation, mature trees and, downtown, colour rules.
paras: An elevation cannot be prepared or coated with a yard under four inches of water, and the irrigation turn is a fixed date rather than a negotiable one, so the schedule is built around it. Mature ash and citrus close to a wall bring their own problems: shade that keeps a surface damp, and debris that will find wet paint if the work is not planned around them.

In the historic districts around the downtown core, colour on a street-facing elevation is governed rather than suggested. That is confirmed before a scheme is agreed with a homeowner, because it is a great deal easier to choose within the guidance than to be corrected after the fact.
notes: Schedule set around the flood irrigation turn
Trees and debris planned for on close elevations
Historic district colour guidance confirmed first

scottsdale-az.lede: Scottsdale approves the colour before it goes on the wall, and the desert palette is narrow on purpose.
paras: Design review and, in the north, community architectural committees govern exterior colour, and the palettes tend to sit within a fairly narrow desert range so that the built environment reads as one thing from a distance. Schemes are settled and approved before any material is ordered. This is the city where painting a house the wrong colour is genuinely expensive.

Sun exposure decides how long it lasts. West and south elevations on a desert-adjacent lot take the worst of it, and darker colours in that range fade measurably faster, so the scheme and the product are chosen with the orientation in mind rather than off a card held up in a north-facing room.
notes: Scheme approved by review before material is ordered
Colour and product chosen against orientation
Darker tones assessed for fade on west elevations

tempe-az.lede: Tempe painting is mostly interiors in small occupied houses that have been repainted many times.
paras: Decades of rental turnover leave walls with layers of colour, patches of different sheen, and the odd area where something was painted over that should have been removed. Preparation on those walls is the job, and a quote that assumes two coats over a sound surface is a quote that will not produce the room in the photograph.

Because the houses are small, occupied and close together, containment, ventilation and hours are planned in. On the exterior, the west-facing walls of these mid-century houses take the same punishment as anywhere in the valley on far less wall area, so they are worth the better product rather than the cheaper one.
notes: Layered previous coats assessed before quoting
Containment and ventilation in occupied rooms
Better product on the small west-facing wall area

peoria-az.lede: Peoria repaints split north and south: committee-approved schemes above the 101, older substrates below.
paras: North of the freeway the houses are recent, the stucco is sound, and the constraint is the community palette and getting the scheme approved alongside anything else being submitted. South Peoria is post-war and 1970s block, where the substrate is often painted masonry and the preparation is a much larger share of the work than the coating is.

The length of the city is a scheduling fact for exterior work in particular. A repaint is weather and temperature dependent, and a crew working the far end of Peoria loses real time to the drive, which is planned for rather than absorbed.
notes: Community palette approval north of the 101
Painted masonry preparation in the older south
Travel across a long city built into the programme

surprise-az.lede: Surprise houses are hitting their second repaint, and the patching matters more than the colour.
paras: Twenty-year-old stucco over frame develops hairline cracking at the corners of openings and along control joints, and paint alone does not fix any of it. Those get cut out and repaired properly before coating, because the alternative is a wall that looks excellent for one summer and shows every crack again by the second. The repair is the job; the colour is the easy part.

In Sun City Grand and the other age-restricted communities the scheme goes to an architectural committee and the work has to fit inside contractor access hours. Exterior painting is weather-dependent and daylight-dependent, so a restricted working day is a real constraint on the calendar and it is priced honestly at the start.
notes: Hairline cracking cut out and repaired before coating
Committee approval on the scheme
Restricted access hours reflected in the programme

goodyear-az.lede: Goodyear is reaching its first real repaint cycle, and the west elevations are showing it first.
paras: Palm Valley, Estrella and the surrounding tracts were finished with production coatings that have now had fifteen or twenty summers of full, unshaded sun. Fade and chalking appear on the west and south walls long before anything else, and a whole-house repaint on the right cycle is considerably cheaper than waiting until the substrate itself needs attention.

Because the stock is uniform, the preparation is predictable: wash, repair the control joints and opening corners, prime what needs priming, coat. Where a house is in a community with a palette, the scheme is approved before the material is bought.
notes: First full repaint cycle on production coatings
West and south walls showing fade first
Control joints and opening corners repaired first

queen-creek-az.lede: Queen Creek elevations are long and low, and there is usually a shop to paint as well.
paras: Houses here spread rather than stack, so a repaint is a lot of wall at reachable height, which is efficient. What adds to it is everything else on the parcel: a shop, a detached garage, walls and gates. Quoting the property rather than the house avoids the situation where a freshly painted home is standing next to an outbuilding that now looks worse than it did.

Access is generally good on these lots, which makes spraying practical and the work quick. Where a parcel is rural the surrounding ground is dustier than a tract garden, so timing and masking are planned rather than assumed.
notes: Whole parcel quoted, not only the house
Long low elevations at reachable height
Dust and masking planned on rural parcels

buckeye-az.lede: Buckeye paint is young but it takes the hardest sun in the valley, so the cycle comes round early.
paras: Verrado, Sundance and Festival Ranch are recent, and the elevations are open to full unbroken west exposure with no mature landscaping to break it. Production coatings under those conditions fade sooner than the same paint would in a shaded inner-valley street, so the useful repaint cycle out here is shorter than a homeowner expects and running it on time is much cheaper than repairing a substrate later.

The city is enormous, and exterior painting is weather and daylight dependent. Material comes in one delivery and the elevations are sequenced to make full days out of the drive, rather than a crew arriving late and leaving early on a wall that needed one uninterrupted pass.
notes: Shorter useful repaint cycle under full exposure
Elevations sequenced to make full days of the drive
One material delivery, staged on site
